def parse_log_line(line):
    """Parse a log line of the form [TIMESTAMP] LEVEL=X msg="the message" into a dict."""
    pattern = r'^\[(.+)\] LEVEL=(\w+) msg="(.*?)"$'
    match = re.match(pattern, line)

            "level": match.group(2),
            "msg": match.group(3)
